_readme: Classes that shared components emit deliberately WITHOUT styles, so the
contract checker does not report them as per-app oversights.
Only add an entry when a class carries no styling in ANY consuming app. A
class missing from one app but present in the others is a real bug — fix
that app's stylesheet instead of listing it here. Every entry needs a
reason, and the checker still prints them on every run so they stay visible.
click-area: Structural wrapper around the children inside .edit-wrap. Has never carried styles in any app — .edit-btn is positioned against .edit-wrap, not this element. Kept because removing the div would change the layout nesting the sheets already rely on.
